messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Auto-shaper applied: high sustained tail latency observed for model-family OrpheusX in us-west-2. Per-model soft quota reduced to protect latency SLOs. Alerting oncall.

maria_oncall: seeing this. metrics: 95p latency spike to ~1.8s, token throughput up 3x in last 10m. Any obvious customer flood? :thinking_face:

sam_sre: a few heavy tenants hitting long-chat loops, also some new async batch jobs. I'm pulling tenant IDs now. We should consider targeted TPU/RPM reshuffle rather than global limits.

liam_ops: can we temporarily drop OrpheusX RPM by 30% and reduce per-request max_tokens to 512 as a graceful measure? That typically buys headroom.

maria_oncall: +1 to max_tokens cap. Also propose disabling function-calling for OrpheusX until we stabilize — that's where many long responses originate.

sam_sre: agree on funcall off for now. Quick command to apply changes (internal console):

```
# admin CLI
rctl quota update --model orpheusx --rpm 120 --tpm 900 --max-tokens 512 --disable-funcall true --reason "auto-shaper -> manual mitigation"
```

sam_sre: I'll run that if we approve.

carol_prod: pinging CS now to ask customers if they see increased throttling. We should include the caveat about reduced max_tokens and funcall paused.

maria_oncall: approved. sam, go ahead. liam, please watch upstream GPU queues for preemptive backpressure.

sam_sre: executed the CLI command. Response: {"status":"ok","quoteresult":"applied","effective_at":"2026-03-17T18:13:44Z"}

incident-bot: Change recorded: quota update by sam_sre. New rpm=120 tpm=900 max_tokens=512 funcall=disabled.

liam_ops: GPU queue depth down ~40% in 60s, p95 latency trending back toward baseline. Still seeing a handful of heavy tenants; adding temporary tenant-level soft-limits.

maria_oncall: good. carol, any customer reports?

carol_prod: CS confirms a single customer reported a failed funcall earlier. We told them it's a mitigation and offered to whitelist if they need throughput for a short window. They asked for ETA.

maria_oncall: ETA unknown yet. We'll reassess in 15m and create an SLA note for affected tenants. Sam, leave a rollback command handy.

sam_sre: rollback command:
```
rctl quota update --model orpheusx --rpm 180 --tpm 1500 --max-tokens 2048 --disable-funcall false --reason "rollback when stable"
```

maria_oncall: handing off paging to sam_sre for the next 30m while I loop in product and CS. sam, can you monitor logs for any error modes caused by funcall off (e.g., 424/unsupported)?

sam_sre: will do. setting watches on funcall error codes + alert if error rate > 0.5%.

pagerduty: NOTE: On-call handover recorded. New owner: sam_sre. Next check-in @ +15m.

maria_oncall: thanks team. keeping thread open. we should prepare a short post-incident note with timeline and mitigation steps once stable. :white_check_mark:
